archetypes.name: drafter-integration
archetypes.rationale: New drafter subprocess introduces complex fallback eligibility branching based on dirty-tree state and sidecar contracts; these cross-component integration paths between launcher and SKILL.md orchestration warrant dedicated scrutiny beyond what correctness/edge-case reviewers cover.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review how `scripts/launch-claude-drafter.sh` integrates with the Step 2b orchestration that will be added to `skills/design/SKILL.md`. Focus on whether the fallback eligibility logic correctly gates on confirmed dirty-tree state only: verify that pre-existing dirty trees, baseline capture failure, absent sidecar on prelaunch exits, and the `MODE=no-baseline` case all permit inline fallback without false-blocking. Check whether partial-failure states — such as `plan.txt` written to disk but `PLAN_WRITTEN=false` in the status file, or a `STATUS=OK` status file alongside a missing `.done` sidecar — can leave the session inconsistent. Examine whether the once-only `.step2b-postplan-inline-retry-done` sentinel is reliably written and re-read across the drafter success path, the postplan failure path, and any resume or re-entry scenario that could reset DESIGN_TMPDIR state. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: contract-separation
archetypes.rationale: The 376-line drafter launcher interleaves path canonicalization, EXIT trap installation, subprocess invocation, JSON scratch promotion, and Python-based delimiter extraction with multiple tmp files; architecture review should verify boundary discipline and cleanup guarantees on all exit paths.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the architecture of `scripts/launch-claude-drafter.sh` with emphasis on contract boundary discipline and resource cleanup. Verify the EXIT trap is installed at exactly the right point — only after `OUTPUT_CANON` is validated and set — and that all scratch tmp files (`${OUTPUT_CANON}.json.$$`, `${OUTPUT_CANON}.extract.$$`, `plan.txt.tmp.$$`, `plan-summary.md.tmp.$$`) are cleaned up on every exit path including subprocess timeout, `exit_code 99` JSON failure, and the Python delimiter extraction raising `SystemExit`. Check whether `write_dirty_tree_sidecar` correctly distinguishes `diff` exit codes: `diff -u` returns 0 (identical), 1 (differ), and 2 (error), but the code only branches on zero vs non-zero, silently treating a `diff` error as dirty rather than unknown. Also verify that the `under_root` containment check using a string prefix comparison (`[[ "$path" == "$root/"* ]]`) is sufficient or whether a path like `$root-extra/file` could pass the check for a root `$root`. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
